modelRegistry.name: Confidence Score Model
modelRegistry.notes: A deterministic, fully explainable formula rather than a trained model — validated through automated tests and an ongoing calibration chart comparing predicted scores against actual outcomes.

modelRegistry.name: Archetype Assignment (nearest-centroid)
modelRegistry.notes: Assigns each customer to the nearest body-profile archetype using height, bust, waist, hip and usual size; a production rollout would move to a clustering model trained on a larger dataset.

modelRegistry.name: Return Interception Decision Engine
modelRegistry.notes: A rules engine layered on top of the confidence score and live stock levels to decide when to offer an exchange instead of a return.

modelRegistry.name: Case Auto-Close Classifier
modelRegistry.notes: Flags an automation-bias watch on SpeedStyle — see Override Wins.

modelRegistry.name: Brand Voice Certification Rubric
modelRegistry.notes: A deterministic rubric checking tone, banned phrasing, emoji policy, apology count and brand-specific rules — it also guards every live AI-generated response before it can go out.

modelRegistry.name: Grievance Radar Risk Score
modelRegistry.notes: A rule-based risk score on delivery delays, with sensitivity tied to the AI Involvement Dial's proactivity setting.

modelRegistry.name: Marketplace Signal Miner
modelRegistry.notes: Surfaces SKU-level aggregate return patterns only — individual marketplace buyer identity is never exposed.
